title: Artifact Workspace UI Simplification and Preview Usability

repairTrigger.summary: Operator could not meaningfully validate WC07 because the artifact workspace UI was confusing, artifact access was unclear, preview appeared empty or unusably small, and the interface used repeated embedded panels.

goal: Replace the confusing artifact review presentation with one clear, constrained, Operator-readable artifact workspace while preserving current-action router authority.
requiredRepairs: Create one clear artifact review area instead of multiple duplicated embedded panels.
Group artifacts by role: Expected Output, Work Card, Implementer Report, Architect Review, Validation Report, Repair Artifacts, Source Evidence, Missing Evidence, Other Support.
Use readable artifact labels as the primary display; full paths must be secondary details only.
Make artifact actions explicit: Preview, Open supporting screen, Not previewable, or Missing.
Make Markdown preview visibly usable with a large readable pane and clear selected-artifact state.
Clearly distinguish artifact evidence from the current routed action form/screen.
Ensure Operator validation routes expose Work Card, Implementer Report, Architect Review, and expected Validation Report.
Ensure Architect review routes expose Work Card, Implementer Report, and expected Architect Review output.
Ensure repair validation routes expose parent Work Card, failed validation, repair Work Card, repair Implementer Report, and expected repair validation output.
Preserve current-action router authority and prevent preview/support navigation from mutating durable workflow state.
Preserve WC04, WC05, and WC06 behaviors.
acceptanceCriteria: The center workspace has one clear artifact review area, not a jumble of duplicated embedded panels.
Artifact groups are visually clear and include expected output, source artifacts, missing evidence, Work Card, Implementer Report, Architect Review, validation, and repair artifacts where applicable.
Artifact labels are readable and do not use full paths as the primary display.
Previewable Markdown artifacts visibly load in a readable pane.
Non-previewable artifacts clearly say they cannot be previewed.
Missing artifacts clearly say they are missing.
Expected output, source artifacts, and missing evidence are visually distinct.
Previewing artifacts remains read-only and does not save, approve, validate, repair, or advance workflow state.
Process/action bar navigation remains support-only and does not become workflow authority.
WC06 left-to-right workflow guide remains intact.
WC08-WC15 behavior does not appear prematurely.
